# Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries — facts

## How it works

- [statement] When setQuerySettings receives a query-shape hash string, representativeQuery is initially absent from $querySettings output; inspection and migration must accommodate entries without that field. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries · also: https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md
- [statement] Backfill is asynchronous and best effort. The first matching execution need not populate representativeQuery; if backfill does not complete, a later matching execution triggers another attempt. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md
- [statement] In the inspected master implementation, settings lookup schedules backfill when BackfillCoordinator::shouldBackfill permits it, then returns the query settings. Representative-query upserts use a separate collection and catch DBException failures. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/query/query_settings/query_settings_service.cpp · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries
- [statement] Percona ClusterSync documentation requires manual query-settings migration after replication finalization. It directs users to identify exported settings by representativeQuery when present and queryShapeHash otherwise. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-20) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-clustersync-for-mongodb/pqs.html · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB 8.3 expands representative-query storage beyond the original 16 MB BSON document limit; this statement concerns representative-query storage capacity, not a general increase to BSON document limits. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3-compatibility.md
- [statement] Downgrading to a version without expanded representative-query capacity restores the 16 MB limit and can lose some representative queries. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3-compatibility.md · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Automatic representative-query backfill starts in MongoDB 8.3 and requires FCV 8.3 or later; a matching query execution schedules the work without user action. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/command/setquerysettings/ · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md
- [statement] The inspected MongoDB master interface exposes dedicated representative-query collection creation and upsert methods. Its downgradeQuerySettings contract derives migrations from feature flags enabled at targetFCV; this development-branch interface alone does not establish released-version behavior. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/query/query_settings/query_settings_service.h · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries
- [statement] SERVER-129203 describes representativeQuery being stored separately in config.queryShapeRepresentativeQueries under featureFlagPQSBackfill, with insert replies including it and update replies omitting it. The issue was resolved Won't Fix with no fix version; its desired consistent reply is not evidence of shipped behavior. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-08) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-129203 · keywords: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries
